title: PAR-20/7G.3 GROUP key and OBJECTS identity closure
scope: Audit the generated GROUP round-trip for unique root and child dictionary-key edges.
Require one ACAD_GROUP root key, one exact named key/handle target, owner-0 NOD identity, and unique OBJECTS handles.
Preserve the existing member-entity and destination-preserving refusal controls in the current fast selector.

sourceChange.change: The retained named-object callback test now counts the ACAD_GROUP root key, requires exactly one named dictionary entry resolving to the imported GROUP, checks owner zero for the actual NOD, and rejects duplicate or missing OBJECTS handles.
sourceChange.reason: Previous find/any checks established presence but allowed duplicate root/child keys, and the order scan did not check NOD owner or all emitted object identities.
